sender_summary: Vijay Shewale drives growth and distribution for Kasparro, an AI Visibility platform that helps brands get discovered, recommended, and chosen by AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Mode. He combines a technical background (React, Flask, Python) with hands-on growth marketing experience, having built organic distribution systems on X and Reddit that generated 1M+ impressions and 18K+ karma through systematic, metrics-first experimentation. He is direct, data-led, and focused on real traction over vanity metrics.
receiver_summary: Aneesh Reddy is Founder & MD of Capillary Technologies, a publicly traded, AI-based cloud-native SaaS loyalty management and customer data platform founded in 2012. Capillary powers loyalty programs for 393+ brands (Asics, Tata, Shell, NASCAR, Jotun, Domino's Pizza) across 43 countries, backed by Warburg Pincus, Sequoia Capital India, Avataar, and Filter Capital. Over a 17+ year journey, Aneesh has driven Capillary's shift from discount-based loyalty to an AI-powered intelligence layer, executing strategic acquisitions (SessionM, Kognitiv, Brierley) to consolidate the category. He has a D/C DISC profile: direct, results-driven, and systems-minded, backing every claim with hard metrics (e.g. 85% higher incremental sales, 4x ROI) and citing Forrester/Gartner validation. He communicates in old-paradigm-vs-new-paradigm contrasts, values team recognition, and is genuinely engaged with how AI is reshaping enterprise discovery and decision-making. As Founder & MD, he is the economic buyer — sole decision-maker on budget and sign-off for a tool like this, not a stakeholder who needs to route it upward.
outreach_goal: Get Aneesh to sign up for a free trial of Kasparro's AI Search Visibility platform so Capillary can see and start managing how it (and the loyalty category) is discovered, recommended, and cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Mode.
offer: Kasparro is an AI Visibility platform that helps brands get discovered, recommended, and chosen by AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode. As enterprise buyers increasingly research vendors and get shortlisted through AI assistants instead of traditional search, Kasparro gives companies like Capillary visibility into and control over how they're represented, cited, and recommended in AI-generated answers — a category most loyalty/CDP competitors haven't claimed yet. Free trial: https://kasparro.com/
pain_points: As AI assistants become a primary research and shortlisting channel for enterprise software buyers, brands with strong traditional SEO can still be invisible or misrepresented in AI-generated recommendations, Most enterprise marketing teams have no visibility today into how AI engines describe, cite, or recommend their brand versus competitors, Capillary has built category leadership through data and analyst validation (Gartner, Forrester) but AI engines don't automatically surface that authority the way search engines do
tone: Direct, data-driven, peer-level — lead with metrics and paradigm-shift framing (old discovery vs AI-driven discovery), no fluff, no generic flattery, respect his time
